import re

HELP = re.compile(r"^Help on (?P<kind>.+?) (?P<name>\S+?):$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z][A-Z ]+$")
NAME = re.compile(r"^\s{4}(?P<module>[\w.]+)(?: - (?P<summary>\S.*?))?\s*$")
URL = re.compile(r"^\s{4}(?P<url>https?://\S+)\s*$")
PATH = re.compile(r"^\s{4}(?P<path>/\S*)\s*$")
SIG = re.compile(r"^\s{4}(?P<name>\w+)\((?P<args>.*)\)\s*$")
DATA = re.compile(r"^\s{4}(?P<name>\w+) = (?P<value>\S.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    head, l_head = {}, []
    funcs, l_func, data, l_data, paras, l_para, skip = [], [], [], [], [], [], []
    section, func, para = "", None, None

    def close_para():
        if para is not None and para["text"]:
            paras.append(para)

    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            close_para()
            para = None
            continue
        m = HELP.match(ln)
        if m:
            head["kind"], head["name"] = m.group("kind"), m.group("name")
            l_head.append(j)
            continue
        if TITLE.match(ln):
            close_para()
            para, func = None, None
            section = ln.strip()
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        if section == "NAME" and NAME.match(ln):
            m = NAME.match(ln)
            head["module"], head["summary"] = m.group("module"), m.group("summary") or ""
            l_head.append(j)
            continue
        if section == "FILE" and PATH.match(ln):
            head["file"] = PATH.match(ln).group("path")
            l_head.append(j)
            continue
        if URL.match(ln) and "reference" not in head:
            head["reference"] = URL.match(ln).group("url")
            l_head.append(j)
            continue
        if section in ("FUNCTIONS", "CLASSES", "METHODS") and SIG.match(ln):
            m = SIG.match(ln)
            func = {"section": section, "name": m.group("name"), "args": m.group("args"), "doc": ""}
            funcs.append(func)
            l_func.append(j)
            continue
        if func is not None and len(ln) - len(ln.lstrip()) > 4:
            func["doc"] = (func["doc"] + " " + ln.strip()).strip()
            l_func.append(j)
            continue
        if section == "DATA" and DATA.match(ln):
            m = DATA.match(ln)
            data.append({"section": section, "name": m.group("name"), "value": m.group("value")})
            l_data.append(j)
            continue
        if para is None:
            para = {"section": section, "text": ""}
        para["text"] = (para["text"] + " " + ln.strip()).strip()
        l_para.append(j)
    close_para()
    blocks = [{"name": "module", "kind": "kv", "lines": l_head, "records": [head]},
              {"name": "functions", "kind": "table", "lines": l_func, "records": funcs},
              {"name": "data", "kind": "table", "lines": l_data, "records": data},
              {"name": "paragraphs", "kind": "table", "lines": l_para, "records": paras}]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
